structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun-launched Solana token named "Effective Accelerationism" (ticker e/acc, contract 7Pyhmi1Qh...pump) migrated from bonding curve to a PumpSwap AMM pool roughly 29 minutes before detection, printing +252% over its first hour on $286k volume against only ~$37k liquidity (7.7x turnover), then crashed -62.9% in the 5 minutes immediately before/at detection. Its project description is a verbatim copy of a viral tweet from Beff Jezos (@beffjezos, real founder of the e/acc movement): "What funding bro? All I get is X payouts and use that money to buy more coffee to dunk on Doomers..." (https://x.com/beffjezos/status/2103593870189858971). The identical name/description appears on at least 5 different Solana contracts in the packet's same_ticker_or_name_tokens list. One of those (CbcyNo7m...), launched ~22 hours earlier, has a $17.7M market cap and $586k liquidity, and matches the coin crypto-news outlets covered as surging "990x" and past $1.7M mcap in 24h (https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/solana-meme-coin-e-acc-market-cap-surpasses-1-7m-in-24-hours, https://www.kucoin.com/square/post/content_6ab731893dd0b40007c35feb). This researched token is a later, much smaller copy riding the same viral tweet text, not the contract that received the news coverage.

narrative.description: The e/acc (Effective Accelerationism) meme is a real, pre-existing internet/tech subculture led by Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon). A specific tweet of his about X-payout-funded coffee vs 'Doomers' appears to have gone viral enough to spawn at least 5 copycat Solana tokens sharing identical name/description within about a day, one of which reportedly hit $17.7M mcap and got crypto-news coverage as a '990x' mover.
narrative.why_spreading: The underlying tweet/movement has genuine reach (Beff Jezos has a large following; e/acc is an established meme), so the narrative itself can pull outside attention. But this specific contract launched ~22h after the news-covered version, already pumped +252% in its own first hour and then dumped -62.9% in the 5 minutes before detection — the attention this pool captured looks like it already peaked and is reversing within its own 30-minute life, not spreading further.

token_connection.why_this_token: This contract shares name, ticker and description text with at least 4 other Solana tokens, but it is not the one referenced by news coverage (that is CbcyNo7m..., launched 22h earlier with 30x the liquidity and mcap). This pool appears to be a copycat cashing in on residual attention from an already-covered pump.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m1amFWqEQm2m4PLv1UNvpcL3C1Ujm6AkzpKoU ($17.7M mcap, $586k liq, launched ~22h earlier, matches KuCoin '990x' coverage); GqmEdRD3zGUZdYPeuDeXxCc8Cj1DBmGSYK97TCwSpump ($166k mcap, near-dead volume); vBiBovJBT39zL3KzdB9rsixjwLoPAR8tFFPCv8Epump and two EACC-ticker tokens, all with $0 liquidity (dead).

authenticity.evidence: Structurally clean (mint/freeze renounced, LP 100% locked, top10 holders excluding pool only 2.7%, RugCheck score 1/very low, 2610 holders in <30 min). But GMGN flags 48 bundler wallets, 71 fresh wallets, 3 snipers among 'top' wallets, buys_per_unique_buyer_h1 of 3.55 (some churn), and an unexplained but high 'top_entrapment_trader_pct' of 0.7753. The +252% h1 pump on 7.7x liquidity turnover followed by a -62.9% crash in the last 5 minutes is consistent with a fast bot/sniper-driven pump-and-dump rather than broad organic adoption.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X/Twitter post data was collected by code, and my own X searches found no posts specifically about this contract address or ticker+CA combination — I cannot see who is actually promoting this specific pool versus the other e/acc contracts, or whether Beff Jezos himself has any connection to it beyond the reused tweet text.

structural_risks: Liquidity is thin relative to volume ($37k liquidity vs $286k h1 volume = 7.7x turnover), so price is highly sensitive to marginal flow in either direction
Entry occurs 5 minutes after detection, i.e. into a pool that just fell -62.9% in the prior 5 minutes — buying into an active down-move, not a stable base
High buy/sell churn (3.55 buys per unique buyer) and 48 bundler + 71 fresh wallets suggest a meaningful share of the early volume is bot/insider rotation rather than fresh organic demand
Being one of 5+ tokens sharing the same name/ticker means future search/attention may flow to the larger, earlier CbcyNo7m... pool instead of this one, capping upside
No project website or socials specific to this token (project_websites and project_socials are empty in the packet) — it is riding a reused description with no independent identity

structured_output.counterargument: The e/acc narrative is genuinely real and has already proven it can pump a token 990x on Solana within the same 24-hour window this token exists in, so residual/rotational attention onto smaller e/acc-named pools is plausible, and pump.fun copycats sometimes catch a second, independent wave of buyers who simply search the ticker and land on whichever pool is currently most liquid or trending on DexScreener at that moment — this one, being newer and currently the top hit in the trigger data, could be that pool for the next cohort of buyers. The very high h1 price change (+252%) also shows this pool is capable of large, fast moves in either direction, so a violent bounce back through +100% from the post-crash entry price is not impossible even if the base rate favors continued downside.

source_coverage.notes: Found the source tweet from @beffjezos (status 2103593870189858971) whose text is copied verbatim into this token's description, and found KuCoin news coverage of a different, larger e/acc contract (CbcyNo7m...) reaching $17.7M mcap / '990x'. Two direct searches for the contract address 7Pyhmi1Qh...pump and for 'beffjezos e/acc pump.fun launch' returned no results specific to this contract. Reddit, Telegram, Discord and the project's own site/socials were not searched due to the 4-call budget; packet shows project_websites and project_socials are empty for this token.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat pump.fun pool riding the name and a reused viral tweet from a real, already-proven e/acc narrative, but it is not the canonical contract that received news coverage (a different, 22-hours-older pool with 30x the liquidity holds that distinction). Structurally the token is clean (renounced authorities, locked LP, low top-10 concentration), which caps downside from a classic LP-pull rug, but the entry point is bad: five minutes after detection, price had just fallen -62.9% in the preceding five minutes after a +252% hour, on thin $37k liquidity churned 7.7x by volume that includes meaningful bundler/fresh-wallet/sniper activity. This looks like a fast pump-and-dump already past its peak rather than a narrative building toward the entry, so the odds of grinding back to +100% before hitting -50% in the next 30 minutes are low, even though the movement behind it is real.
